```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("_common.R")

# Pages read_rds() only. Written by r/chesterfield_afford.R.
op <- read_rds("data/chesterfield_onepager.rds")
afford <- op$afford
ctx <- op$ctx

usd <- scales::label_dollar(accuracy = 1)
usd0 <- \(x) usd(round(x))

# One row per role: the latest figure we could confirm ("current", else the
# only figure there is), plus any proposed figure shown beside it.
cur <- afford |>
  arrange(role, factor(status, c("current", "stale", "proposed"))) |>
  slice(1, .by = role)
prop <- afford |>
  filter(status == "proposed") |>
  select(role, proposed_pay = annual_pay)
roles <- cur |>
  left_join(prop, by = "role") |>
  mutate(proposed_pay = if_else(status == "proposed", NA_real_, proposed_pay)) |>
  arrange(desc(annual_pay))

# Label for any figure that is not a confirmed, full-year, as-published current rate.
tag_for <- \(status, source_date, basis) paste0(
  case_match(status,
    "proposed" ~ " (proposed)",
    "stale" ~ paste0(" (", format(source_date, "%b %Y"), " posting)"),
    .default = ""
  ),
  if_else(basis == "hourly", " (hourly x 2,080 hrs)", "")
)
roles <- roles |> mutate(role_label = paste0(role, tag_for(status, source_date, basis)))

police <- afford |> filter(role == "Police officer") |> slice(1)
rent_short_min <- -max(roles$rent_gap)
rent_short_max <- -min(roles$rent_gap)
two_ff <- 2 * police$annual_pay

# The bullets and chart title below state these claims; stop the render if the
# data ever stops supporting them.
stopifnot(
  "claim: every role is short of the median rent" = all(roles$rent_gap < 0),
  "claim: two police incomes clear the median-home income" = two_ff > ctx$income_for_home,
  "claim: every salary is below 80% AMI (1 person)" = all(roles$annual_pay < ctx$ami80_1p),
  "claim: best salary affords about half the median home" =
    between(max(roles$max_price) / ctx$median_value, 0.45, 0.55)
)
asm <- ctx$assumptions
```

::: {layout-ncol=3}
**`{r} usd0(ctx$median_rent)`** a month: Chesterfield's median rent

**`{r} usd0(police$max_rent)`** a month: the most a `{r} usd0(police$annual_pay)` police or fire starting salary affords

**`{r} usd0(ctx$income_for_home)`** a year: income needed to afford the median home
:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-pay-vs-afford
#| fig-width: 7.2
#| fig-asp: 0.34
#| fig-alt: "Horizontal bars of starting pay for seven Chesterfield public-service roles, from about $37,000 for instructional assistants to $60,147 for police officers and firefighters. A vertical line at about $65,000 marks the income needed to afford the median rent and a line near $117,000 marks the income needed for the median home; every bar falls short of both."

plot_df <- roles |>
  mutate(
    label = fct_reorder(role_label, annual_pay)
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(annual_pay, label)) +
  geom_col(fill = rva_pal[1], width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = usd0(annual_pay)), hjust = 1.1, size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ctx$income_for_rent, color = rva_pal[2], linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ctx$income_for_home, color = rva_pal[2], linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = ctx$income_for_rent + 1500, y = 1.3, hjust = 0, size = 3,
           color = rva_ink[["primary"]], label = "Needed for\nmedian rent") +
  annotate("text", x = ctx$income_for_home - 1500, y = 1.3, hjust = 1, size = 3,
           color = rva_ink[["primary"]], label = "Needed for\nmedian home") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(), breaks = seq(0, 125000, 25000), limits = c(0, 132000), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Every starting salary falls short of both lines",
    subtitle = "Annual starting pay, one earner, Chesterfield County, 2026",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_rva(base_size = 10)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-roles

neg <- \(x) if_else(x < 0, paste0("-", usd0(-x)), paste0("+", usd0(x)))
tbl <- roles |>
  transmute(
    Role = role_label,
    `Starting pay (as of)` = paste0(usd0(annual_pay), " (", format(source_date, "%b %Y"), ")"),
    `Proposed FY27` = if_else(is.na(proposed_pay), "", usd0(proposed_pay)),
    `Max rent / mo (vs. median)` = paste0(usd0(max_rent), " (", neg(rent_gap), ")"),
    `Max home price` = usd0(max_price)
  )

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  kbl(tbl, align = "lrrrr") |> kable_styling(c("condensed", "striped"))
} else {
  knitr::kable(tbl, format = "markdown", align = "lrrrr")
}
```

- Every role shown earns less than the median rent requires: the gap runs from `{r} usd0(rent_short_min)` to `{r} usd0(rent_short_max)` a month.
- The best-paid starting salary here affords a home of about `{r} usd0(max(roles$max_price))`, roughly half the county's `{r} usd0(ctx$median_value)` median home value.
- Two police or firefighter starting incomes (`{r} usd0(two_ff)`) are just above the `{r} usd0(ctx$income_for_home)` the median home needs.
- Every starting salary is below HUD's 80% area-median-income limit for one person (`{r} usd0(ctx$ami80_1p)`).

::: {.callout-note}
## How to read these figures
One earner, starting pay. Affordable rent is 30% of gross income. Home price assumes a `{r} scales::percent(asm$rate, accuracy = 0.01)` 30-year mortgage (Freddie Mac, week of `{r} format(asm$rate_date, "%b %d, %Y")`), `{r} scales::percent(asm$down_pct, accuracy = 1)` down, the real estate tax rate in the county's FY2027 proposed budget (`{r} sprintf("$%.2f", asm$tax_rate * 100)` per $100), homeowners insurance at `{r} scales::percent(asm$ins_rate, accuracy = 0.01)` of price and mortgage insurance at `{r} scales::percent(asm$pmi_rate, accuracy = 0.1)` of the loan (these last two are our assumptions). Hourly pay is annualized at 2,080 hours, so school-year workers earn less. Teacher and bus driver pay is the FY26 scale from February 2026; FY27 pay is proposed, not confirmed adopted. Deputy sheriff pay is from a January 2026 posting; the 911 officer figure is the class-spec minimum. Median rent and value are 2020-2024 ACS.
:::
